pages.text: A FUNCTION line starts at x=5 with the function name. PARAMETER lines below it name the inputs, RESULT lines the outputs. Then follows the code block.
A parameter may have a default value. A caller can leave such a parameter out. Results start with the default value of their type.
$(1)FUNCTION greet$(br)  PARAMETER name STRING "World"$(br)  PARAMETER mark CHAR '!'$(br)  RESULT result STRING$(br)BEGIN$(br)  ASSIGN result "Hello, " ⊕ name ⊕ mark ;$(br)END FUNCTION$()
When the function ends, the last values of its results go back to the caller.
